outcome: neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)/special care nursery requirements
cohort: Singleton deliveries over 20 weeks gestation at a tertiary provider in Melbourne, Australia, between January 1, 2011 and December 31, 2020 (n=52,795)
finding: Pacific Islander women have higher BMI and gestational diabetes rates compared to Australian/European women, which contributes to an increased likelihood of adverse perinatal outcomes such as pre-eclampsia and neonatal hypoglycemia.
